title: System settings
description: Manage SEO, payment gateways, statistics, custom code, and site basics.

groupDescriptions.site: Set the public site name and URL; sender, payment callback, and image links use the site URL for defaults.
groupDescriptions.auth: Control registration, Cloudflare Turnstile, secure sign-in, email verification, and email-domain allow-lists. Secret Keys are encrypted with APP_KEY and never returned in plaintext.
groupDescriptions.email: Choose the service used for registration verification emails. Keep it disabled and leave credentials empty during development; enable one provider and enter its credentials for production. Passwords, API keys, and AccessKeys are encrypted with APP_KEY.
groupDescriptions.media: Manage upload size and image watermarks. The development sender is only an example; production must use a provider-verified mailbox.
groupDescriptions.seo: Manage the site description, keywords, sitemap, crawler rules, and public discovery switch.
groupDescriptions.gateway: Multiple payment providers can be enabled in parallel and offered to members. Configure each provider separately and enter its required credentials before enabling it; official API, Webhook/IPN, and success/cancel URLs are pre-filled defaults and remain editable. Credentials are encrypted with APP_KEY.
groupDescriptions.code: Configure site verification, ad verification, and controlled site snippets.
groupDescriptions.other: Manage the site URL, upload limits, discovery switch, image watermark, and failed-image fallback.

paypal.title: PayPal
paypal.description: Fiat payments. Create a PayPal App, enter its Client ID and Client Secret, and configure the Webhook ID.

xcash.title: XCash
xcash.description: Crypto payments. The XCash project Appid and HMAC key sign requests and verify webhooks.

nowpayments.title: NOWPayments
nowpayments.description: Crypto payments. The API Key creates invoices and the IPN Secret verifies callbacks.

gatewayURLsTitle: Official and callback URLs (defaults are editable)

fields.email_aliyun_reply_to_address: Use Alibaba Cloud console reply address

hints.auth_registration_enabled: When disabled, new accounts cannot register; existing accounts are unaffected.
hints.auth_turnstile_enabled: The login/registration switches take effect only when this global switch is on. Fill both keys.
hints.auth_turnstile_site_key: The public Site Key from the Cloudflare Turnstile widget. It is safe to send to the browser.
hints.auth_turnstile_secret_key: The private Secret Key used only by the backend with Cloudflare siteverify; leave blank to keep the saved secret.
hints.auth_login_turnstile_enabled: Render Turnstile on sign-in and enforce it on the backend.
hints.auth_registration_turnstile_enabled: Render Turnstile on registration and verification-email resend, and enforce it on the backend.
hints.auth_registration_email_verification_ena: New accounts must click the email link before sign-in; accounts created by an administrator are treated as verified.
hints.auth_registration_email_whitelist_enable: When enabled, only the domains below may register. Use one domain per line, or comma/semicolon separators.
hints.auth_registration_email_whitelist_domain: For example example.com or company.org. Do not enter addresses; this list is never exposed publicly.
hints.auth_registration_verification_expiry_mi: Recommended 5–1440 minutes; defaults to 30. Expired links require a new email.
hints.email_enabled: When disabled, no registration verification emails are sent. The provider is called only when registration email verification is enabled. Keep it off during development.
hints.email_provider: Choose one: generic SMTP, Alibaba Cloud DirectMail API, or Resend API. Only the selected provider is called.
hints.email_from_address: Sender address for SMTP/Resend and the default for Alibaba Cloud API; it must be verified with the provider.
hints.email_from_name: Name shown to recipients as the sender.
hints.email_reply_to: Optional reply address; Alibaba Cloud requires it to be verified in the console.
hints.email_smtp_host: For example smtpdm.aliyun.com, smtp.gmail.com, or your company mail server.
hints.email_smtp_port: STARTTLS commonly uses 587 and SSL/TLS commonly uses 465; avoid port 25 on Alibaba Cloud ECS.
hints.email_smtp_username: Usually the complete sender email address.
hints.email_smtp_password: SMTP password or provider-specific app password; leave blank to keep the saved password.
hints.email_smtp_encryption: Use STARTTLS or SSL/TLS in production; no encryption is only for local testing.
hints.email_aliyun_endpoint: Alibaba Cloud DirectMail API endpoint; defaults to https://dm.aliyuncs.com.
hints.email_aliyun_access_key_id: Use a RAM user AccessKey ID with only the DirectMail send permission.
hints.email_aliyun_access_key_secret: The matching AccessKey Secret; do not use a full-access root account key.
hints.email_aliyun_account_name: A sender address verified in the Alibaba Cloud DirectMail console; it must match the sender address.
hints.email_aliyun_reply_to_address: Verify the reply address in the Alibaba Cloud DirectMail console before enabling this.
hints.email_resend_endpoint: Resend API endpoint; defaults to https://api.resend.com.
hints.email_resend_api_key: API key created in the Resend console, usually starting with re_.
hints.payment_default_gateway: Recommendation for new orders only; every other enabled and complete provider remains available for member selection.
hints.payment_paypal_base_url: Pre-filled with the official PayPal API root for the selected environment; change it only for a compatible gateway.
hints.payment_paypal_client_id: Client ID for the selected environment from PayPal Developer > Apps & Credentials.
hints.payment_paypal_client_secret: Secret paired with the Client ID; leave blank to keep the saved secret.
hints.payment_paypal_webhook_id: Webhook ID created in PayPal Webhooks; used for server-side verification.
hints.payment_paypal_return_url: Return to the order detail page after approval, for example https://img.example.com/orders/ORDER_ID?payment=success.
hints.payment_paypal_cancel_url: Return to the order detail page after cancellation, for example https://img.example.com/orders/ORDER_ID?payment=cancelled.
hints.payment_xcash_base_url: Pre-filled with https://pay.xca.sh; change it only for a compatible gateway, not to the site webhook URL.
hints.payment_xcash_app_id: Appid assigned by the XCash project.
hints.payment_xcash_hmac_key: HMAC key for the XCash project; the server uses it for XC-Signature.
hints.payment_xcash_callback_url: Public HTTPS POST webhook, for example https://img.example.com/api/v1/payment-gateways/xcash/webhook.
hints.payment_xcash_return_url: Return to the order detail page after payment; it does not confirm payment.
hints.payment_nowpayments_base_url: Pre-filled with https://api.nowpayments.io; change it for a compatible gateway or deployment endpoint.
hints.payment_nowpayments_api_url: Pre-filled with the official API URL and editable for the deployment environment.
hints.payment_nowpayments_webhook_url: Copy this into NOWPayments Dashboard > Settings > Payments > Instant payment notifications; production requires public HTTPS.
hints.payment_paypal_api_url: Pre-filled with the official PayPal API URL for the selected environment and editable for the deployment environment.
hints.payment_paypal_webhook_url: Add this URL in PayPal Developer > Webhooks and use the matching Webhook ID; production requires public HTTPS.
hints.payment_paypal_success_url: Return to the order detail page after PayPal checkout; final status comes from verified PayPal webhooks.
hints.payment_xcash_api_url: Pre-filled with the official Xcash API URL https://pay.xca.sh; change it for a compatible gateway if needed.
hints.payment_xcash_webhook_url: Copy this into the Xcash project notification URL; production requires public HTTPS.
hints.payment_nowpayments_api_key: NOWPayments account API Key for invoice creation and queries.
hints.payment_nowpayments_ipn_secret: NOWPayments IPN Secret used to verify x-nowpayments-sig.
hints.payment_nowpayments_callback_url: Pre-filled from the site URL; production requires a public HTTPS callback such as https://img.example.com/api/v1/payment-gateways/nowpayments/webhook.
hints.payment_nowpayments_success_url: Return to the order detail page after payment; entitlement follows verified IPN.
hints.payment_nowpayments_cancel_url: Return to the order detail page after cancellation.
hints.watermark_text: Applied to originals and previews during upload; ASCII letters, digits, and common URL symbols are supported. Leave blank to use FastImg.
hints.watermark_domain: Appended to the watermark, for example img.example.com; leave blank to omit it.
hints.watermark_fallback_image_url: Shown in the member UI when an image cannot load; use a public HTTPS URL or site-absolute path. Leave blank for the built-in FastImg fallback watermark.
